title: baeria chrysostoma subsp. hirsutula
intro: Baeria chrysostoma subsp. hirsutula, commonly known as desert baeria, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of desert baeria include antimicrobial and antifungal properties, which can be used to treat infections and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
